title: Reviews of your written answers
body: A person reviews your written answers. You can let AI draft notes for that reviewer; it sees only the question, the rubric and your answers, never your name or history. It never grades you.
saveFailed: Your choice couldn't be saved. Nothing changed.
label: Let AI draft notes for my reviewer
legend.title: What each status means
legend.pending: No one has reviewed it yet.
legend.notMet: Some criteria aren't met yet. The reviewer's note says which.
legend.clarification: Your reviewer has a question. Reply under the answer in the lesson.
legend.automatic: The course's fixed check confirmed each criterion from your own words. You can still ask a person for a second opinion.
